leadText: Mount Tensei (Japanese: テンセイ Mount Tensei) is an -exclusive location and one of the settings for I Choose You!. It is the highest peak in the Raizen Mountain Range or the Raizen Mountains (Japanese: ライゼン Raizen Mountains). When is obtained through Mystery Gift, it mentions that the OT (Original Trainer) is MT. Tensei.
